ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Aegis Vopak Terminals Limited's subsidiary is acquiring a new 36,000 MT specialized ammonia storage terminal at Pipavav Port for INR 5.25 billion, significantly expanding its chemicals and gas logistics portfolio. This substantial capacity addition, effective immediately, is a related-party transaction as the asset is being acquired from Aegis Logistics Limited, a promoter, though stated to be on an arm's length basis.
